evidenceIsolation.policy: About has its own implementation evidence and handoff. It must not inherit or merge Restore Preview evidence.

figmaDisposition.reason: The About visual design has not been authored by the user. Do not synthesize, infer, capture, componentize, or write an About F2 design. Preserve the original Figma About pages unchanged.

feedbackRoutePolicy.replacement: About-owned feedback-entry overlay and explicit external-action contract
feedbackRoutePolicy.reason: The 19-control About denominator contains feedback entry controls, not a second form renderer/state owner.

r2aInstrumentation.identityPolicy: All controls use version, update, repository, license, contribution, team, feedback and rating business keys. Ordinals, selector hashes, labels and DOM position are prohibited.

guards: one pending operation at a time; duplicate starts resolve duplicate
completion requires current requestId, kind and requestEpoch
cancel increments requestEpoch and later completion resolves stale
external action retains an explicit target business key
feedback entry stays inside the About owner without reviving the excluded feedback route

externalActionSemantics.loading: Only the active external target is aria-busy and disabled.
externalActionSemantics.failure: The target exposes aria-invalid and a deterministic error title.

ariaAndFocus.feedbackEntry: About-owned modal dialog with aria-modal, labelled title, exact restore-focus and deterministic initial focus
ariaAndFocus.externalActions: explicit safe external-action target; loading and error remain target-local
ariaAndFocus.controlNames: every stamped button/row retains a data-settings-key accessible-name source

figmaReadOnlyBaseline.knownStructuralGap: The responsive master subtree was read as INSTANCE=0 during F0 preparation. The serial writer must repair it through canonical components while preserving downstream instances and reactions.

figmaDecisionsRequired: Update shared About row, external-link action, update-state and feedback-entry dialog components before page masters.
Preserve clear external-link semantics and right-align trailing values/actions.
Do not create a separate feedback form or revive the excluded feedback route in this page family.
Repair Phone and Tablet masters only; Landscape inherits Tablet and Compact/Fold are prohibited.
Repair Page 24 masters through real components, then let Page 23 instances inherit. Detached frames and screenshots are prohibited.
Preserve reactions. Figma may not change UiEvent, state owner, async guards or external-action contract.

admission.exclusionReason: User explicitly removed About from the Figma queue.
